name: Fossify Phone
tagline: Make and take calls without ads or tracking
description:
Fossify Phone replaces the dialer that came with your phone. You get a keypad, your contacts and favourites, your call history, and a block list for the numbers you never want to hear from again. On a phone with two SIM cards you pick which one each call goes out on.

There are no ads and no analytics, and it asks for only the permissions a phone app actually needs. Colours and themes are yours to change, and it is part of the wider Fossify family of simple, open replacements for the built-in apps.

Like any dialer, Android will ask you to make it your default phone app before it can place calls.
